brief:
Israeli occupation forces have maintained a siege on al-Ras al-Ahmar south of Tubas for the 36th consecutive day, isolating the area from surrounding regions, Shehab Wire reported. Abdullah Bisharah, head of the joint council of Aatuf and al-Ras al-Ahmar villages, said the blockade continues to cut off the settlement.

The siege has kept the area sealed off from its surroundings without immediate indication of when the closure will be lifted.

title: Israeli forces extend blockade of al-Ras al-Ahmar for 36th day
